title: 2012 Leaf Draft Blue #20 Fletcher Cox Mississippi State Bulldogs Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 Leaf Draft sports trading card features Fletcher Cox, a rookie player from the Mississippi State Bulldogs football team. The card is part of the base set and has a blue parallel/variety, making it a unique addition to any collection. 

The card number is 20 and it is manufactured by Leaf. It is a great find for fans of football and sports trading cards, especially those who collect rookie cards. This card is a must-have for any collector looking to add to their collection of sports memorabilia.
